description: Gate 7 common test data (07 §2 / ADR-0008 re-evaluation): t0 start{r1, avoid_chip, long}; t1 off-route -> cancel{r1} + 'checking route'; t2 search_finished{r1, ok} -> discarded_late, slot freed -> start{r2, reroute, long}; t3 search_finished{r2, ok} -> adopted. MonoMs are JSON numbers. 'request' steps stand in for triggers not wired into dc_tick yet (TODO). 'expect_starts' lists the planner_cmds start{req_id, priority, distance_class} each step must emit (none if absent); outside any plan the class is long.
